Title: Appearance in the Commission of Economy and Competitiveness of the Congress of Deputies
text: APPEARANCE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE GOVERNING COMMISSION OF THE FROB IN THE COMMISSION OF ECONOMY AND COMPETITIVENESS OF THE CONGRESS OF DEPUTIES February 5, 2014 Thank you, Mr President, ladies and gentlemen. Complying with the control mandate contained in article 56 of Law 9/2012 on the restructuring and resolution of credit institutions, of November 14, I appear before this Committee on Economy and Competitiveness as President of the Governing Committee of the Fund for Orderly Bank Restructuring (FROB) which, as you know, is composed of representatives of the Bank of Spain, the Ministry of Economy and Competitiveness and the Ministry of Finance and Public Administration. The purpose of this appearance is to report on the activities carried out by the FROB since September 10, 2013, the date on which I last appeared before the Subcommittee on Bank Restructuring and Financial Sanitation established by this Commission and through which, to date, the legal obligation of accountability had been complied with. I would like, first of all, to recall that last January the financial assistance programme (agreed in July 2012) ended, after the assessments of the European Commission, the ECB and the IMF, whose final report will be made public in the coming days, have certified compliance with the conditions set out in the Memorandum of Understanding and verified that all its objectives have been achieved. In the months since the beginning of the programme, the FROB has been involved, in close collaboration with the Bank of Spain, in the formulation and execution of the recapitalisation and restructuring plans of the entities that have received public aid, in the cleaning up of the balance sheet of these entities through the transfer of assets to Sareb and in the execution of complex burden-sharing exercises between shareholders and creditors. of the entity and the Public Treasury. In recent months, the focus of the activity has been shifting from these activities of planning and management of restructuring and resolution processes, to those related to the disposal of FROB's holdings in financial institutions and the promotion of corporate operations. In the report that I will present to you in this session, where I will detail the actions carried out in the last quarter, I will give you an account, in the first place, of the conduct of the sale processes of the entities in resolution, that is, of those classified as not viable alone. I am referring to Banco Gallego, NCG Banco and Catalunya Banc. Secondly, I will inform you about the current situation of the corporate operation of Banco CEISS and Unicaja Banco. Thirdly, I will briefly explain the sale of the Caja Rural Comarcal de Mota del Cuervo as part of its resolution process. Fourthly, I will comment on the current state of the arbitration processes initiated by the entities in which the FROB has a stake, aimed at investors who may have been affected by the deficient marketing of hybrid instruments. Finally, I will comment on the follow-up work of the restructuring and resolution plans that the FROB must carry out in the exercise of the functions entrusted to it by Law 9/2012, I will briefly refer to the actions of Sareb in this period, and I will conclude with an overview of the financial situation of the FROB. Next to present the sale processes of the entities in resolution, starting with NCG Banco. 1. SALES PROCESSES ENTITIES RESOLUTION a. NCG BANCO NCG BANCO's resolution plan established the obligation for the Spanish authorities to initiate contacts with potential buyers of the entity by mid-2015 at the latest, and they must make their best efforts to complete the sale no later than the end of 2016. As you will recall, on March 25, 2013, the Governing Committee of the FROB awarded by tender to the international consulting firm McKinsey, in collaboration with the investment bank Nomura, the project for the preparation of a report in which the different management strategies of the entities participated by the FROB including NCG were described and evaluated. McKinsey raised the accelerated divestment in this entity as the best possible option, given the risk of deterioration of the franchise, with the consequent loss for the public patrimony. Consequently, the Governing Committee of the FROB, in July 2013, awarded the contract for the analysis and eventual sale of NCG to BNP Paribas (BNP). This contract established that the process would be structured in two phases: a first phase, in which BNP would analyze the economic and financial situation of the entity and press the market appetite, so that the FROB could decide if the conditions were met to launch the sale process; and a second phase, more limited in time, in which the award of the entity would be decided, where appropriate, after the corresponding competitive procedure. BNP informally contacted different credit institutions and private equity funds. The invitation to non-bank financial institutions is a novelty in this type of process, introduced in order to maximize the effectiveness of the competitive process. However, in order to ensure the proper management of the entity once privatized and obtain certainty about the commitment of potential buyers, the Bank of Spain established a series of additional conditions to be met by the interested investment and private equity funds, which were transmitted to them through the contracted investment bank. Once the potential buyers with an interest in the acquisition of the entity were identified, they were given access to the necessary information to assess it. The object of the sale included the shares representing 62.75% of the capital of NCG Banco controlled by the FROB, and the shares representing 25.58% of the share capital owned by the Deposit Guarantee Fund, obtained after the application of the liquidity mechanism offered by this body to retail investors who once acquired hybrid instruments of the entity. Therefore, NCG shares that were delivered in exchange to the holders of the preferred shares and subordinated debt affected by the burden-sharing exercises, and which did not have access to the liquidity mechanism of the Deposit Guarantee Fund, were left out of the sale process. Similarly, the invitation letter configured the selection process that would be developed in two phases: a first phase, in which the offers submitted by the entities invited to participate would be evaluated; and a second phase, which would be attended only by the three potential successful bidders who had submitted the best bids in the first phase. This second phase would only take place when the bid ranked second in the first phase did not deviate by more than 50% and by more than 200 million euros from the best valued. Potential buyers had to submit their offers initially before Friday, December 13, a deadline that was extended until December 16. The basic contract of the sale, which was also delivered to potential acquirers, also included certain commitments or guarantees in favor of NCG, common in this type of operation, but did not include any asset protection scheme (EPA) on any portfolio of the entity. In the sale process, six offers were received that were analyzed by the technical services of the FROB, with the collaboration of BNP according to the aforementioned criteria. From this analysis it emerged that the binding offer presented by Banco Etcheverr92a-Grupo Banesco was the one with the best valuation. Since the second-ranked bid deviated by more than 50% and by more than db200 million from the first, the second phase was not initiated. The total price offered by Banco Etcheverr92a-Grupo Banesco was 1,003 million euros, which includes the price of 913 million euros for the basic perimeter, as well as an additional 90 million euros for the portfolio of non-performing loans. That offer did not propose any relevant amendments to the contract. The consideration offered in the binding offer would be paid as follows: a5 313 million euros on the date of consummation of the operation -plus 90 million euros from the portfolio of non-performing loans- a5 db100 million on 30 June 2016 a5 db200 million on 30 June 2017 a5 db300 million on 30 June 2018 Consequently, on December 18, 2013, the Governing Committee of the FROB awarded the contract for the sale of 88.33% of the shares representing the share capital of NCG Banco to Banco Etcheverr92a-Grupo Banesco, proceeding on the same date to the signing of the private purchase agreement. Its effectiveness is conditioned to compliance with the legally established requirements, among which is the obtaining of the mandatory authorizations by the national and community authorities. In short, the sale procedure of the entity has been governed at all times by the objective of ensuring the most efficient use of public resources, in accordance with the principles of Law 9/2012, once the viability of the integration project of NCG Banco into the Banesco Group has been guaranteed, as the Bank of Spain must ratify. In this way, the legal mandate that requires the FROB to develop a competitive, transparent and non-discriminatory procedure that maximizes the sale price and minimizes the use of public resources has been fulfilled. I now comment on the completion of the sale process of Banco Gallego. b. BANCO GALLEGO As I have already had occasion to explain to you, Banco Gallego's resolution was originally contemplated within NCG Banco's resolution plan, which required its sale before 30 April 2013 or, in another case, the orderly liquidation of the entity. On April 19, 2013, the Governing Committee of the FROB agreed to the award of Banco Gallego to Banco Sabadell because it considered that its offer was the most competitive in accordance with the established evaluation criteria. The completion of the operation was conditional on obtaining the relevant authorisations, the injection of capital by the FROB for an amount of 245 million euros and the carrying out of the management actions of hybrid equity and subordinated debt instruments. The FROB formalized these actions, once the mandatory authorizations were obtained, on September 30, 2013. Finally, on October 28, the purchase agreement by which Banco Sabadell acquired 100% of Banco Gallego became effective. With this, Banco Gallego's resolution plan was fully complied with, through its integration into a solid financial group, avoiding the alternative scenario of bankruptcy liquidation, which would have implied higher costs for the public treasury. c. CATALONIA BANK (CX) As you know, Catalunya Banc's resolution plan foresees that the entity will be disposed of through a competitive auction, no later than the end of 2016. As in the case of the NCG entity, the consulting firm McKinsey advised the FROB to execute the divestment in the short term in order to minimize the cost of resolving the entity for the taxpayer. Consequently, on July 18, 2013, the Governing Committee of the FROB, after the processing of a competitive process, awarded N1 Corporate Finance, S.A. the contract for the analysis and eventual sale of Catalunya Banc. This contract establishes that the process is structured in two phases. A first analysis and market contrast, which allows the FROB to assess whether the conditions to sell the entity are met, and a second stage, more limited in time, in which this sale process would be executed, where appropriate. The initial analysis work is almost complete. N1 hired Ernst & Young to prepare the financial, labour, tax and legal due diligence (DD) of Catalunya Banc. At the same time, N1 is identifying the entity's contingencies and value levers. Within the strategy of the divestment process, the possibility of initiating in parallel the sale of a portfolio of the entity is contemplated, provided that this increases the return obtained by the FROB, taking into account the principles and objectives provided for in the Law. 2. UNICAJA-BANCO CEISS CORPORATE OPERATION To conclude this first section of my speech, allow me to explain the current situation of the corporate operation by which Unicaja would take a controlling stake in Banco CEISS, within the framework of the resolution plan of the latter entity. This operation has made substantial progress in recent weeks. As you know, in May 2013 it was approved, both by the FROB and by the Executive Committee of the Bank of Spain, and subsequently by the European Commission, the modification of the resolution plan of Banco CEISS, to include an offer from Unicaja Banco on capital instruments issued by that entity. Unicaja Banco's offer, approved by its Board of Directors on 15 July 2013, became effective on 26 November, with the registration with the CNMV of the prospectus corresponding to the offer to acquire Banco CEISS' capital instruments obtained by investors in hybrid instruments of this entity after the burden-sharing exercise carried out by the FROB. This offer consisted of an exchange of Banco CEISS shares held by wholesale investors for shares of Unicaja Banco S.A., and, for retail investors, an exchange of instruments convertible into Banco CEISS shares for a basket of instruments convertible into Unicaja Banco shares. The offer was supported by two reports by independent experts1, which showed that the value of the securities offered by Unicaja Banco was higher than the market value of CEISS instruments, with an average premium of 46%. 1 Oliver Wyman and International Financial Analysts. In addition, the aforementioned offer established a double condition for its success: the first, non-waivable, of reaching 75% of the nominal shares of CEISS in the hands of wholesale investors, and the second, capable of being dispensed by Unicaja Banco, of reaching 75% of the global nominal of CEISS shares and convertible bonds. Likewise, the offer established the obligation for investors who accepted it to waive any claim against CEISS or Unicaja, in relation to the marketing of hybrid equity instruments by the former. Under these conditions, the success of the offer would have prevented retail investors who accepted it from compensating for the costs arising from possible defects in the marketing of subordinated debt and preferred shares by the savings banks that constituted Banco CEISS. For this reason, on November 26, 2013, the FROB made public the approval of a mechanism allowing retail investors accepting Unicaja Banco's offer to request it, and provided that it was successful, to review, by an independent expert, the marketing process of the preferred shares and subordinated debt of CEISS that were sold to them at the time. This review would take place following the criteria established by the Monitoring Committee for Hybrid Capital and Subordinated Debt Instruments, created by RD-Law 6/2013. In this way, whenever the operation progresses, those investors who have taken advantage of the review mechanism and obtain the support of the independent expert, will be compensated in cash by the FROB for their initial investment after discounting the value of the Unicaja Banco instruments received in the exchange and the spread of interest charged. This action is part of the framework established by Law 9/2012, which empowers the FROB to exercise actions that reduce the cost to the public treasury of the resolution of non-viable entities. In fact, the review mechanism not only offers CEISS retail investors protection similar to that offered to retail investors who purchased hybrid instruments issued by other entities under resolution, but has also made it possible to reduce the obstacles to the consummation of a corporate transaction that entails appreciable benefits both for the entities involved and for the public patrimony. Likewise, Unicaja Banco approved the so-called accompanying mechanism, through which retail investors who had accepted the offer, and did not obtain a positive result from the application of the review mechanism, would be compensated by Unicaja Banco, provided that the operation was successful, with a cash figure that represents an average of 17.5% of the initial nominal invested in preferred or subordinated debt and that will be added to the value of the securities offered by Unicaja in the exchange. On January 21, 2014, the deadline for acceptance of the offer ended, with the following data: a5 Acceptance in the wholesale tranche (CEISS shareholders): 99.16% a5 Global acceptance: 60.66% Therefore, the first of the non-waivable conditions by Unicaja Banco is met, as there is an acceptance by shareholders that far exceeds the established minimum. This is not the case, however, with the second condition that the overall acceptance exceed 75% of the total nominal value of the instruments to which the offer was directed. Under these conditions, Unicaja Banco showed its willingness to waive compliance with the second condition and, therefore, to proceed with the exchange of the instruments of investors who had accepted its offer, provided that the FROB agreed to offer additional guarantees to cover litigation, as a step prior to the effectiveness of that waiver. The FROB considered it appropriate to meet Unicaja's offer, based on its evaluation of its impact on Banco CEISS' resolution cost. It should be remembered that the alternative scenario to the completion of the corporate operation would involve the nationalization of the entity through the conversion into capital, in principle, unpaid, of the 604 million necessarily convertible bonds, remunerated above 8%, which were subscribed by the FROB as financial support. This would also imply the need to cover through new capital injections the minimum regulatory capital required in the framework of the solvency test to be carried out by the single supervisory mechanism this year; and, finally, it would mean the injection, in any case, of new funds to cover the contingencies caused, precisely by the arbitration or judicial procedures associated with the commercialization of hybrid instruments. That is, the non-acceptance of the requested guarantees would not be able to prevent the FROB from facing, predictably, the contingencies covered by them at the time of taking over the entity in case the offer did not prosper, in addition to exposing itself to the risk of losing totally or partially the capital invested in an eventual competitive process. In fact, the additional cost that the resolution of this entity would entail for the FROB, if the operation with Unicaja Banco were not successful, could be close to 1000 million euros, according to a report prepared by an independent expert, at the request of the FROB. Taking into account all the above, the European Commission has been requested to authorize the provision of the aforementioned guarantee to cover the possible litigation of investors who have not accepted Unicaja's offer. The granting of this aid represents a maximum additional cost for the FROB of 241 million euros. The FROB would cover, up to this amount, 71% of the negative impact of the claims of the holders of the necessary and contingently convertible obligations that did not accept the offer, and Banco CEISS the remaining 29%. In order to grant the requested guarantees, the resolution plan of Banco CEISS and the term sheet annexed to the decision of the European Commission of 13 May 2013 must be amended, where, in addition, some changes must be included in the restructuring commitments of Banco CEISS. This is due to the need to adjust the capacity reduction foreseen in the original plan to the increase in public aid that this entity would receive. In any case, the FROB has defined the basic lines of the modification of the resolution plan that have received the approval of the Bank of Spain. The planned review is at an advanced stage of negotiation with the technical services of the European Commission, whose college of commissioners must formally approve the reform of the plan. Thus, once the necessary formal authorizations are obtained, Unicaja will waive the condition of minimum acceptance of the offer, which will allow the execution of the exchange of securities by which Unicaja Banco would acquire control of Banco CEISS. The process is expected to be completed in the coming weeks and, in any case, before 31 March 2014. This will allow the completion of an operation that benefits the entire financial system and implies a substantial saving of public resources. 3. CAJA RURAL COMARCAL MOTA DEL CUERVO After reviewing the sale processes of the entities in resolution, I will now analyze, due to its special singularity, the sale of the Caja Rural Comarcal Mota del Cuervo, which, however, is outside the resolution and restructuring processes undertaken within the framework of the financial assistance program. The Caja Rural Comarcal Mota del Cuervo is a credit cooperative, of very small size, with total assets of 82.55 million euros (0.003% of the total assets of the Spanish banking system) and with a volume of deposits close to 74 million euros. On January 3, 2014, the Bank of Spain informed the FROB of the result of the inspection carried out on the Caja Rural, which revealed a significant deterioration in credit investment. This caused such a significant coverage deficit that it had resulted in Caja Rural's own resources, referring to the financial statements of 30 June 2013, amounting to a negative amount of db1.2 million, representing a regulatory capital deficit of db5.8 million in relation to the minimum required. On the other hand, in the development of the inspection actions of the Bank of Spain, significant deficiencies were also detected in the control of credit risk and excess concentration of exposures, which together with the small size of the entity, the lack of profitability it presented and the deficient corporate governance existing at that time, showed that Caja Rural de Mota del Cuervo did not have the capacity to correct the deficits indicated by itself and ensure its future viability. Likewise, the Bank of Spain informed in its letter to the FROB of the existence of a preliminary agreement of intentions for the possible integration of Caja Rural de Mota del Cuervo into Caja Rural de Albacete, Ciudad Real and Cuenca, Sociedad Cooperativa de Cr8edito (Globalcaja) dated December 2, 2013, which would have solved the difficulties presented by the entity. The aforementioned preliminary agreement was presented by the governing council of Caja Rural de Mota del Cuervo for approval by the general assembly of the entity at its meeting held on December 29, 2013. The general director of the entity read at the assembly the summary report of the inspection of the Bank of Spain that detailed the deficiencies detected in the operation and internal control of the entity, the economic and financial situation as of June 30, 2013, with express indication of the breach of the solvency regulations to that date due to the deficits of own resources and main capital, as well as the recognition of the impossibility of Caja Rural de Mota del Cuervo to return to compliance with said regulations by its own means. Despite this information transmitted by the CEO, the assembly agreed to reject the integration agreement in Globalcaja, which led to the resignation of all members of the governing board of the entity. In this scenario, on January 14, 2014, the Bank of Spain agreed to open the resolution process of Caja Rural de Mota del Cuervo, understanding that the entity was unviable by its own means, and decreed the replacement of the administrative body, designating the FROB as provisional administrator. On that same date, immediately after the Bank of Spain agreed to the resolution of the entity, the FROB agreed to the sale of the business of the box as an emergency measure, in the exercise of the powers granted by current regulations, after concluding that this was the most suitable instrument of resolution of the entity. Likewise, as is mandatory, the Governing Committee of the FROB approved, also as an emergency measure, the economic value of the entity, which stood at a negative amount of 698,000 euros, and the liquidation value, which was estimated at a negative value of 19.81 million euros. After the processing by the FROB of a competitive process of urgent sale due to the circumstances of the case, the Caja Rural de Albacete, Ciudad Real y Cuenca (Globalcaja) was awarded the sale, having offered a price for the total contributions of the Caja Rural Comarcal Mota del Cuervo of 1,275,800 euros, with the nominal value of all contributions of 383,000 euros. The partners received the consideration for their cash contributions. I would therefore like to emphasise that the sale has been carried out expeditiously at no cost to the taxpayer, to depositors and creditors, or even to the members of the cooperative, who may have received a consideration higher than the value of their contributions. The alternative, consisting of bankruptcy liquidation, would, on the contrary, have put at risk the assets of depositors not covered by the Deposit Guarantee Fund and, by affecting its assets, caused costs for the public treasury. Thus, with this sale process, the principles and objectives of public interest established in the regulations on the restructuring and resolution of credit institutions are fully complied with. 4. FOLLOW-UP OF ARBITRATION PLANS and PROCESSES a. Recovery and resolution plans I will now briefly comment on the situation of the restructuring and resolution plans of the sector, and the arbitration processes in which the FROB participates. As honourable Members know, one of the fundamental elements of the restructuring of the Spanish banking sector lies in the need to resize the industry, in order to adapt the business to the new conditions of demand. This motivation has been included in the resolution and restructuring plans of the entities that have received public aid, imposing for this purpose a set of demanding requirements that aim to gradually achieve significant reductions in personnel, branches and assets. In addition, these measures are essential to comply with European State aid rules and minimise distortion of competition. In this way, the plans -both of the entities in which the FROB participates, and of those that received public aid through the subscription, by the FROB, of contingently convertible obligations- include an average reduction in the number of branches of 35%, a reduction in staff of the order of 30% and an average contraction of the balance sheets close to 25%. The latest available data, referring to the end of 2013, show a remarkable degree of progress in the fulfillment of these plans, having already reached decreases of 27% in offices, 23% in staff and 16% in assets. In any case, the requirements of the plans are not exhausted with the previous impositions, but also extend to the fulfillment of certain objectives of solvency, efficiency and liquidity. Well, all these commitments are being properly implemented. In the specific case of Grupo BFA-Bankia, some appreciable progress has been made since my last appearance. BFA-Bankia's restructuring plan foresaw that before 31 December 2013, the Group would undertake the simplification of its structure for which it would have to opt for one of the following two strategies: either a merger of the two entities into a single one or, alternatively, the renunciation of BFA's banking licence, to become a holding company, whose main asset would be Bankia shares. In execution of the commitment made last December, the FROB chose to promote the second of the options, that is, the renunciation of BFA to its banking license and plan its execution over the coming months. On the other hand, and with regard to the possible sale of the FROB's stake in Bankia through BFA, which amounts to 68.39% of the capital, the FROB will proceed to hire in the coming days an investment bank or independent financial advisor, in charge of carrying out an analysis of the divestment strategy. It is, logically, a major operation that should only be undertaken after identifying the moment and the execution modality that maximizes the return for public finances. b. Arbitral proceedings Allow me to refer now to the arbitration proceedings relating to the marketing among retail customers of the preferred shares and subordinated debt of the entities owned by the FROB (BFA-Bankia, NCG Banco and Catalunya Banc), which are already either completed or in an advanced stage of processing. As you know, the arbitrations have been executed in accordance with the criteria published on 17 April 2013 by the Monitoring Committee on Hybrid Capital and Subordinated Debt Instruments, created by RD-l 6/2013 of 22 March. NCG Banco has already concluded the process, which began in July 2012, having obtained a positive award of just over 58,000 customers, 62% of those who submitted a request for arbitration to the entity, and for an amount of 496 million euros. Catalunya Banc started the process in October 2012 and the deadline for submitting applications ended in July 2013. So far, claims corresponding to 37,176 holders (35.1% of those submitted) have been accepted by the independent expert, amounting to 338 million euros. The arbitration proceedings are expected to be concluded in the coming months. Finally, the deadline for submitting requests for arbitration at BFA-Bankia was extended from 18 April to 16 July 2013. The independent expert has so far accepted the applications corresponding to 174,100 holders, representing 76.3% of those submitted, for an amount of 2,245 million euros. The awards are progressing at a good pace and procedures with a volume of 1,056 million euros, corresponding to 117,685 clients, have already been resolved favorably to the client. The entity expects the arbitration process to be completed in the first half of 2014. In summary, the arbitration processes undertaken have allowed more than 260,000 clients to have already obtained or will soon obtain compensation equivalent to the nominal value of their investment. This represents more than half of retail investors who had access to arbitrations and more than 60% of those who have requested it. These figures will increase somewhat in the coming weeks as ongoing procedures are completed. 5. SAREB I now turn briefly to the Company for the Management of Assets from Bank Restructuring (Sareb), which continues to progressively intensify its activity of asset management and disposal. The commercial activity of Sareb d0 a non-financial entity although 45% owned by the FROB d0 has been advancing rapidly in the sale of real estate and financial assets through the planned channels; that is, sale of wholesale portfolios, sale of singular assets and retail sale through the ceding entities. In particular, following the adoption of a new commercial strategy in the second half of the year, Sareb managed to sell more than 9,000 real estate assets in 2013 as a whole. The gross cash flow generated exceeded db3.8 billion in 2013, allowing a cash redemption of bonds issued in payment of transferred assets amounting to db1,445 million. Finally, I would like to mention the launch of the first FABs (Bank Assets Fund), Sareb's unique and exclusive instruments aimed at professional investors registered with the CNMV, which have aroused great interest for the flexibility they offer. 6. FINANCIAL SITUATION OF THE FROB To conclude my speech today, I will briefly review the financial situation of the FROB. As I had the opportunity to explain to you in the last hearing, the net worth of the FROB at the end of 2012 was -21,832 million euros, and this is due to the deterioration experienced by the economic value of its portfolio of capital instruments of credit institutions in restructuring or resolution. The Financial Facility (FFA) contract signed between the FROB, the Kingdom of Spain and the ESM, despite considering the Kingdom of Spain as a debtor vis-88-vis the ESM, provides that the entire loan is transferred to the FROB, either in the form of a loan or in the form of a capital contribution so that the latter, in turn, send the funds to financial institutions, in addition to Sareb. Taking into account the above, the conversion of part of the State loan to the FROB d0 mirror of the ESM loan to the Treasury d0 into equity endowment was proposed. This possibility is expressly provided for in the contract between the two parties, although it requires that, in advance, the written authorization of the ESM has been obtained. This authorization was granted on November 8, 2013. Consequently, with effect from December 11, 2013, the partial conversion of the Treasury loan, up to an amount of 27,170 million euros, was agreed in contribution to the equity endowment of the FROB. Thus, with this operation, the equity situation of the FROB is significantly reinforced, which, at the moment, has a positive net worth close to 5,000 million euros. 7. CONCLUSIONS I shall conclude, ladies and gentlemen. As I said at the beginning, within the framework of the financial assistance program that has just concluded, the FROB has carried out intense work in close collaboration with the supervisor, to facilitate the process of reorganization, recapitalization and restructuring of the Spanish financial system with the aim of minimizing the cost to the taxpayer. Although this has been much higher than desirable, it is true that it is at levels comparable to that supported in other European countries that have not required financial assistance from the EU and well below, in terms of GDP, that granted in the rest of the countries that have subscribed to financial assistance programs. Likewise, I sincerely believe that the FROB has contributed to mitigating the social cost of the inadequate commercialization of hybrid instruments, particularly through the management of arbitration procedures that have been effective, so far, in satisfying the most vulnerable investors. Finally, I believe that the FROB has already made notable progress in the task of disposing of public participation in nationalized entities and in promoting, in coordination with the Bank of Spain, corporate operations that contribute to improving the organization of the financial industry and reduce the public cost associated with its necessary restructuring. After the sale of Banco de Valencia, Banco Gallego and Nova Caixa Galicia and the development of the integration processes of Cajatres into the Ibercaja Group and Banco CEISS into the Unicaja Group, the remaining operations are limited to the three entities that remain under the control of the FROB: BFA-Bankia, Catalunya Banc and Banco Mare-Nostrum. In the speech I commented on the existing plans to conduct the divestment process which, as it cannot be otherwise, will be guided by the objectives of public interest set by law and, in particular, by the minimization of the cost to the taxpayer of restructuring our banking system. Thanks a lot.
text_original: COMPARECENCIA DEL PRESIDENTE DE LA COMISIN RECTORA DEL FROB EN LA COMISIN DE ECONOMA Y COMPETITIVIDAD DEL CONGRESO DE LOS DIPUTADOS 5 de febrero de 2014 Gracias Presidente, Seoras. Cumpliendo con el mandato de control recogido en el artculo 56 de la Ley 9/2012 de reestructuracin y resolucin de entidades de crdito, de 14 de noviembre, comparezco ante esta Comisin de Economa y Competitividad como Presidente de la Comisin Rectora del Fondo de Reestructuracin Ordenada Bancaria (FROB) que, como saben, est compuesta por representantes del Banco de Espaa, el Ministerio de Economa y Competitividad y del Ministerio de Hacienda y Administraciones Pblicas. El objeto de esta comparecencia es informar de las actividades desarrolladas por el FROB desde el pasado 10 de septiembre de 2013, fecha en la que comparec por ltima vez ante la Subcomisin de Restructuracin Bancaria y Saneamiento Financiero establecida por esta Comisin y a travs de la que, hasta la fecha, se haba dado cumplimiento a la obligacin legal de rendicin de cuentas. Quisiera, en primer lugar, recordar que el pasado mes de enero concluy el programa de asistencia financiera (acordado en julio de 2012), despus de que las valoraciones de la Comisin Europea, el BCE, y el FMI, cuyo informe final se har pblico en los prximos das, hayan certificado el cumplimiento de las condiciones recogidas en el Memorando de Entendimiento y constatado que todos sus objetivos se han alcanzado. En los meses transcurridos desde el comienzo del programa, el FROB ha estado involucrado, en estrecha colaboracin con el Banco de Espaa, en la formulacin y ejecucin de los planes de recapitalizacin y restructuracin de las entidades que han recibido ayudas pblicas, en la limpieza del balance de estas entidades mediante el traspaso de activos a la Sareb y en la ejecucin de complejos ejercicios de reparto de la carga entre los accionistas y acreedores de la entidad y la hacienda pblica. En los ltimos meses, el foco de la actividad ha ido migrando desde estas actividades de planificacin y gestin de los procesos de restructuracin y resolucin, a las relativas a la enajenacin de las participaciones del FROB en las entidades financieras y la promocin de operaciones corporativas. En el informe que les presentar en esta sesin, donde detallar las actuaciones realizadas en el ltimo trimestre, les dar cuenta, en primer lugar, de la conduccin de los procesos de venta de las entidades en resolucin, es decir de aquellas calificadas como no viables en solitario. Me refiero a Banco Gallego, NCG Banco y Catalunya Banc. En segundo lugar, les informar sobre la situacin actual de la operacin corporativa de Banco CEISS y Unicaja Banco. En tercer lugar, expondr brevemente la venta de la Caja Rural Comarcal de Mota del Cuervo en el marco de su proceso de resolucin. En cuarto lugar, comentar el estado actual de los procesos de arbitraje iniciados por las entidades participadas por el FROB, dirigidos a los inversores que han podido estar afectados por la comercializacin deficiente de instrumentos hbridos. Finalmente, comentar la labor de seguimiento de los planes de restructuracin y resolucin que debe llevar a cabo el FROB en el ejercicio de las funciones que le encomienda la ley 9/2012, me referir brevemente a las actuaciones de la Sareb en este periodo, y concluir con una resea sobre la situacin financiera del FROB. Paso a continuacin a exponer los procesos de venta de las entidades en resolucin, empezando por NCG Banco. 1. PROCESOS DE VENTA ENTIDADES RESOLUCIN a. NCG BANCO El plan de resolucin de NCG BANCO estableca la obligacin para las autoridades espaolas de iniciar contactos con potenciales compradores de la entidad como muy tarde a mediados de 2015, debiendo realizar sus mejores esfuerzos para concluir la venta no ms tarde de finales de 2016. Como sus Seoras recordarn, el 25 de marzo de 2013 la Comisin Rectora del FROB adjudic mediante licitacin a la consultora internacional McKinsey, en colaboracin con el banco de inversin Nomura, el proyecto para la realizacin de un informe en el que se describieran y valoraran las diferentes estrategias de gestin de las entidades participadas por el FROB incluida NCG. McKinsey plante la desinversin acelerada en esta entidad como la mejor opcin posible, habida cuenta del riesgo de deterioro de la franquicia, con el consiguiente quebranto para el patrimonio pblico. En consecuencia, la Comisin Rectora del FROB, en julio de 2013, adjudic el contrato de anlisis y eventual venta de NCG a BNP Paribas (BNP). En dicho contrato se estableca que el proceso se estructurara en dos fases: una primera fase, en la que BNP analizara la situacin econmico-financiera de la entidad y pulsara el apetito de mercado, con el fin de que el FROB pudiera decidir si se daban las condiciones para lanzar el proceso de venta; y una segunda fase, ms limitada en el tiempo, en la que se decidira, en su caso, la adjudicacin de la entidad tras el correspondiente procedimiento competitivo. BNP contact informalmente con diferentes entidades de crdito y fondos de private equity. La invitacin a entidades financieras no bancarias supone una novedad en este tipo de procesos, introducida con objeto de maximizar la efectividad del proceso competitivo. No obstante, con objeto de asegurar la adecuada gestin de la entidad una vez privatizada y obtener certidumbre sobre el compromiso de los potenciales compradores, el Banco de Espaa estableci una serie de condiciones suplementarias que deban cumplir los fondos de inversin y private equity interesados, que fueron transmitidas a los mismos a travs del banco de inversin contratado. Identificados los potenciales compradores con inters en la adquisicin de la entidad, se les dio acceso a la informacin necesaria para valorar la misma. El objeto de la venta comprenda las acciones representativas del 62,75% del capital de NCG Banco controlado por el FROB, y las acciones representativas del 25,58% del capital social titularidad del Fondo de Garanta de Depsitos, obtenido tras la aplicacin del mecanismo de liquidez ofrecido por este organismo a los inversores minoristas que en su da adquirieron instrumentos hbridos de la entidad. Se dejaban, por lo tanto, fuera del proceso de venta las acciones de NCG que fueron entregadas en canje a los titulares de las participaciones preferentes y deuda subordinada afectados por los ejercicios de reparto de la carga, y que no accedieron al mecanismo de liquidez del Fondo de Garanta de Depsitos. De igual forma, la carta de invitacin configuraba el proceso de seleccin que se desarrollara en dos fases: una primera fase, en la que se valoraran las ofertas presentadas por las entidades invitadas a participar; y una segunda fase, a la que concurriran nicamente los tres potenciales adjudicatarios que hubieran presentado las mejores ofertas en la primera fase. Esta segunda fase solo tendra lugar cuando la oferta clasificada en segundo lugar en la primera fase no se desviara ms de un 50% y en ms de 200 millones de euros respecto a la mejor valorada. Los potenciales compradores deban presentar sus ofertas inicialmente antes del viernes 13 de diciembre, plazo que fue ampliado hasta el 16 de diciembre. El contrato base de la compraventa, que fue entregado tambin a los potenciales adquirentes, recoga asimismo determinados compromisos o garantas en favor de NCG, habituales en este tipo de operaciones, pero no inclua ningn esquema de proteccin de activos (EPA) sobre cartera alguna de la entidad. En el proceso de venta se recibieron seis ofertas que fueron analizadas por los servicios tcnicos del FROB, con la colaboracin de BNP conforme a los criterios antes referidos. De este anlisis se desprendi que la oferta vinculante presentada por la entidad Banco Etcheverra-Grupo Banesco era la que obtena una mejor valoracin. Dado que la oferta valorada en segundo lugar se desvi en ms de un 50% y en ms de 200 millones de euros respecto de la primera, no se procedi al inicio de la segunda fase. El precio total ofertado por Banco Etcheverra-Grupo Banesco fue de 1.003 millones de euros, que comprende el precio de 913 millones de euros por el permetro bsico, as como 90 millones de euros adicionales por la cartera de fallidos. Esta oferta no propona modificaciones relevantes al contrato. La contraprestacin ofrecida en la oferta vinculante se abonara del siguiente modo:  313 millones de euros en la fecha de la consumacin de la operacin -mas los 90 millones de euros de la cartera de fallidos-  100 millones de euros el 30 de junio de 2016  200 millones de euros el 30 de junio de 2017  300 millones de euros el 30 de junio de 2018 En consecuencia, con fecha 18 de diciembre de 2013, la Comisin Rectora del FROB adjudic el contrato de venta del 88.33% de las acciones representativas del capital social de NCG Banco a Banco Etcheverra-Grupo Banesco, procedindose en idntica fecha a la firma del contrato privado de compraventa. La efectividad del mismo est condicionada al cumplimiento de los requisitos legalmente previstos, entre los que se encuentra la obtencin de las autorizaciones preceptivas por parte de las autoridades nacionales y comunitarias. En suma, el procedimiento de venta de la entidad se ha regido en todo momento por el objetivo de asegurar la utilizacin ms eficiente de los recursos pblicos, de acuerdo con los principios de la Ley 9/2012, una vez garantizada -tal y como deber ratificar el Banco de Espaa- la viabilidad del proyecto de integracin de NCG Banco en el Grupo Banesco. De este modo, se ha cumplido con el mandato legal que exige al FROB desarrollar un procedimiento competitivo, transparente y no discriminatorio que maximice el precio de la venta y minimice el uso de los recursos pblicos. Paso a continuacin a comentar la culminacin del proceso de venta de Banco Gallego. b. BANCO GALLEGO Como ya tuve ocasin de exponer a sus Seoras, la resolucin de Banco Gallego se contemplaba originariamente dentro del plan de resolucin de NCG Banco, que impona su venta antes de 30 de abril de 2013 o, en otro caso, la liquidacin ordenada de la entidad. Con fecha 19 de abril de 2013, la Comisin Rectora del FROB acord la adjudicacin de Banco Gallego a Banco Sabadell por considerar que su oferta era la ms competitiva de acuerdo con los criterios de valoracin establecidos. El perfeccionamiento de la operacin estaba condicionado a la obtencin de las autorizaciones pertinentes, a la inyeccin de capital por parte del FROB por un importe de 245 millones de euros y a la realizacin de las acciones de gestin de instrumentos hbridos de capital y deuda subordinada. El FROB formaliz estas actuaciones, una vez obtenidas las autorizaciones preceptivas, el 30 de septiembre de 2013. Finalmente, el pasado 28 de octubre se hizo efectivo el contrato de compraventa por el que Banco Sabadell adquiri el 100% de Banco Gallego. Con ello, se daba pleno cumplimiento al plan de resolucin de Banco Gallego, mediante su integracin en un grupo financiero slido evitando el escenario alternativo de liquidacin concursal, que hubiera implicado mayores costes para el erario pblico. c. CATALUNYA BANC (CX) Como saben sus Seoras, el plan de resolucin de Catalunya Banc prev que la entidad sea enajenada mediante una subasta competitiva, no ms tarde de finales de 2016. Al igual que en el caso de la entidad NCG, la consultora McKinsey aconsej al FROB la ejecucin en el corto plazo de la desinversin con objeto de minimizar el coste de la resolucin de la entidad para el contribuyente. En consecuencia, el 18 de julio de 2013 la Comisin Rectora del FROB, tras la tramitacin de un proceso competitivo, adjudic a N+1 Corporate Finance, S.A. el contrato de anlisis y eventual venta de Catalunya Banc. En dicho contrato se establece que el proceso se estructura en dos fases. Una primera de anlisis y contraste de mercado, que permita al FROB valorar si se dan las condiciones para vender la entidad, y una segunda etapa, ms limitada en el tiempo, en la que se ejecutara, en su caso, este proceso de venta. El trabajo de anlisis inicial est prcticamente finalizado. N+1 contrat a Ernst&Young para la elaboracin de las due diligencie (DD) financiera, laboral, fiscal y legal de Catalunya Banc. Paralelamente, N+1 est identificando las contingencias y palancas de valor de la entidad. Dentro de la estrategia del proceso de desinversin, se contempla la posibilidad de iniciar en paralelo la venta de alguna cartera de la entidad, siempre que ello incremente el retorno obtenido por el FROB, atendiendo a los principios y objetivos previstos en la Ley. 2. OPERACIN CORPORATIVA UNICAJA-BANCO CEISS Para terminar este primer apartado de mi intervencin, permtanme que exponga la situacin actual de la operacin corporativa por la que Unicaja tomara una participacin de control de Banco CEISS, en el marco del plan de resolucin de esta ltima entidad. Esta operacin ha experimentado un avance sustancial en las ltimas semanas. Como saben sus Seoras, en mayo de 2013 se aprob, tanto por el FROB como por la Comisin Ejecutiva del Banco de Espaa, y posteriormente la Comisin Europea, la modificacin del plan de resolucin de Banco CEISS, para incluir una oferta de Unicaja Banco sobre instrumentos de capital emitidos por aquella entidad. La oferta de Unicaja Banco, aprobada por su consejo de administracin de 15 de julio de 2013, se hizo efectiva el pasado 26 de noviembre, con el registro en la CNMV del folleto correspondiente a la oferta de adquisicin de los instrumentos de capital de Banco CEISS obtenidos por los inversores en instrumentos hbridos de esta entidad tras el ejercicio de reparto de la carga efectuado por el FROB. Esta oferta consista en un canje de las acciones de Banco CEISS en manos de inversores mayoristas por acciones de Unicaja Banco S.A., y, para los inversores minoristas, un canje de los instrumentos convertibles en acciones de Banco CEISS por una cesta de instrumentos convertibles en acciones de Unicaja Banco. La oferta se apoyaba en dos informes de expertos independientes1, que evidenciaban que el valor de los ttulos ofrecidos por Unicaja Banco era superior al valor de mercado de los instrumentos de CEISS, con una prima media del 46%. 1 Oliver Wyman y Analistas Financieros Internacionales. Adems, la mencionada oferta estableca una doble condicin para su xito: la primera, no renunciable, de alcanzar el 75% del nominal de acciones de CEISS en manos de inversores mayoristas, y la segunda, susceptible de ser dispensada por Unicaja Banco, de alcanzar el 75% del nominal global de acciones y bonos convertibles de CEISS. Asimismo, la oferta estableca la obligatoriedad de que los inversores que la aceptaran renunciasen a cualquier reclamacin contra CEISS o Unicaja, en relacin con la comercializacin de instrumentos hbridos de capital por parte de la primera. En estas condiciones, el xito de la oferta hubiera impedido a los inversores minoristas que la aceptasen resarcirse de los costes derivados de eventuales defectos en la comercializacin de deuda subordinada y participaciones preferentes por parte de las cajas de ahorro que constituyeron Banco CEISS. Por este motivo, el FROB hizo pblica el 26 de noviembre de 2013 la aprobacin de un mecanismo por el que se permita a los inversores minoristas aceptantes de la oferta de Unicaja Banco que as lo solicitasen, y siempre que la misma prosperase, la revisin, por parte de un experto independiente, del proceso de comercializacin de las participaciones preferentes y deuda subordinada de CEISS que les fueron vendidas en su da. Esta revisin se producira siguiendo los criterios establecidos por la Comisin de Seguimiento de Instrumentos Hbridos de Capital y Deuda Subordinada, creada por el RD-Ley 6/2013. De este modo, siempre que la operacin progrese, aquellos inversores que se hayan acogido al mecanismo de revisin y obtengan el respaldo del experto independiente, sern compensados en efectivo por el FROB por su inversin inicial una vez descontados el valor de los instrumentos de Unicaja Banco recibidos en el canje y el diferencial de intereses cobrados. Esta actuacin se inscribe en el marco que establece la Ley 9/2012, que faculta al FROB para ejercer acciones que permitan reducir el coste para el erario pblico de la resolucin de entidades no viables. De hecho, el mecanismo de revisin no solo ofrece a los inversores minoristas de CEISS una proteccin similar a la ofrecida a los inversores minoristas que adquirieron instrumentos hbridos emitidos por otras entidades en resolucin, sino que, adems, ha permitido reducir los obstculos para la consumacin de una operacin corporativa que conlleva beneficios apreciables tanto para las entidades involucradas como para el patrimonio pblico. Asimismo, Unicaja Banco aprob el denominado mecanismo de acompaamiento, mediante el cual los inversores minoristas que hubieran aceptado la oferta, y no obtuvieran un resultado positivo de la aplicacin del mecanismo de revisin, seran compensados por Unicaja Banco, siempre que la operacin prosperase, con una cifra en efectivo que supone de media un 17,5% del nominal inicial invertido en preferentes o deuda subordinada y que se sumar al valor de los ttulos ofrecidos por Unicaja en el canje. El pasado 21 de enero de 2014 finaliz el plazo de aceptacin de la oferta siendo los datos de la misma los siguientes:  Aceptacin en el tramo mayorista (accionistas de CEISS): 99,16%  Aceptacin global: 60,66% Por lo tanto, se cumple la primera de las condiciones no renunciable por parte de Unicaja Banco, al existir una aceptacin por parte de los accionistas que supera con creces el mnimo establecido. Esto no ocurre, sin embargo, con la segunda condicin que exiga que la aceptacin global superara el 75% del valor nominal total de los instrumentos a los que se diriga la oferta. En estas condiciones, Unicaja Banco mostr su voluntad de dispensar el cumplimiento de la segunda condicin y, por lo tanto, de proceder al canje de los instrumentos de los inversores que hubieran aceptado su oferta, siempre que el FROB aceptara ofrecer garantas adicionales para la cobertura de la litigiosidad, como paso previo a la efectividad de esa renuncia. El FROB consider apropiado atender el ofrecimiento de Unicaja, basndose en su evaluacin del impacto del mismo sobre el coste de resolucin de Banco CEISS. Cabe recordar que el escenario alternativo a la culminacin de la operacin corporativa supondra la nacionalizacin de la entidad mediante la conversin en capital, en principio, no retribuido, de los 604 millones de obligaciones necesariamente convertibles, retribuidas por encima del 8%, que fueron suscritas por el FROB como apoyo financiero. Esto implicara, adems, la necesidad de cubrir mediante nuevas aportaciones de capital los mnimos de capital regulatorio exigidos en el marco de la prueba de solvencia que realizar el mecanismo nico de supervisin este mismo ao; y, finalmente, significara la inyeccin, en todo caso, de nuevos fondos para cubrir las contingencias ocasionadas, precisamente por los procedimientos arbitrales o judiciales asociados a la comercializacin de instrumentos hbridos. Es decir, la no aceptacin de las garantas solicitadas, no lograra evitar que el FROB debiera hacer frente, previsiblemente, a las contingencias cubiertas por las mismas en el momento de hacerse cargo de la entidad en caso de que la oferta no prosperase, adems de exponerse al riesgo de perder total o parcialmente el capital invertido en un eventual proceso competitivo. De hecho, el coste suplementario que supondra para el FROB la resolucin de esta entidad, si no prosperase la operacin con Unicaja Banco, podra situarse prximo a los 1000 millones de euros, de acuerdo con un informe elaborado por un experto independiente, a instancias del FROB. Teniendo en cuenta todo lo anterior, se ha solicitado a la Comisin Europea la autorizacin de la prestacin de la garanta mencionada para cubrir la posible litigiosidad de los inversores que no han aceptado la oferta de Unicaja. La concesin de esta ayuda supone un coste adicional mximo para el FROB de 241 millones de euros. El FROB cubrira, hasta este montante, el 71% del impacto negativo de las reclamaciones de los titulares de las obligaciones necesarias y contingentemente convertibles que no aceptaron a la oferta, y Banco CEISS el 29% restante. Para otorgar las garantas solicitadas, debe procederse a la modificacin del plan de resolucin de Banco CEISS, y del term sheet anexo a la decisin de la Comisin Europea de 13 de mayo de 2013, donde, adems, deben incluirse algunos cambios en los compromisos de restructuracin de Banco CEISS. Ello obedece a la necesidad de ajustar la reduccin de capacidad prevista en el plan original al aumento de la ayuda pblica que recibira esta entidad. En todo caso, el FROB ha definido las lneas bsicas de la modificacin del plan de resolucin que han recibido la conformidad del Banco de Espaa. La revisin prevista se encuentra en fase avanzada de negociacin con los servicios tcnicos de la Comisin Europea, cuyo colegio de comisarios deber aprobar formalmente la reforma del plan. As, una vez se obtengan las autorizaciones formales necesarias, Unicaja materializar la renuncia a la condicin de aceptacin mnima de la oferta, lo que permitir la ejecucin del canje de ttulos por el que Unicaja Banco adquirira el control de Banco CEISS. Est previsto que el proceso finalice en las prximas semanas y, en todo caso, antes del 31 de marzo de 2014. Ello permitir la culminacin de una operacin que beneficia al conjunto del sistema financiero e implica un ahorro cuantioso de recursos pblicos. 3. CAJA RURAL COMARCAL MOTA DEL CUERVO Tras revisar los procesos de venta de las entidades en resolucin, paso a continuacin a analizar, por su especial singularidad, la venta de la Caja Rural Comarcal Mota del Cuervo, que, no obstante, se sita al margen de los procesos de resolucin y restructuracin acometidos en el marco del programa de asistencia financiera. La Caja Rural Comarcal Mota del Cuervo es una cooperativa de crdito, de tamao muy reducido, con unos activos totales de 82,55 millones de euros (el 0,003% de los activos totales del sistema bancario espaol) y con un volumen de depsitos cercano a los 74 millones de euros. El pasado 3 de enero de 2014, el Banco de Espaa comunic al FROB el resultado de la inspeccin efectuada a la Caja Rural, que puso de manifiesto un importante deterioro de la inversin crediticia. Este provocaba un dficit de cobertura tan significativo que haba dado lugar a que los recursos propios de la Caja Rural, referidos a los estados financieros de 30 de junio de 2013, se situaran en un importe negativo de 1,2 millones de euros, lo que supone un dficit de capital regulatorio de 5,8 millones de euros en relacin con los mnimos requeridos. Por otra parte, en el desarrollo de las actuaciones inspectoras del Banco de Espaa, se detectaron asimismo importantes deficiencias en el control del riesgo crediticio y excesos de concentracin de exposiciones, lo que unido a la reducida dimensin de la entidad, la falta de rentabilidad que presentaba y el deficiente gobierno corporativo existente en ese momento, evidenciaba que Caja Rural de Mota del Cuervo no tena capacidad para subsanar por s misma los dficits sealados y asegurar su viabilidad futura. Asimismo, el Banco de Espaa inform en su escrito al FROB de la existencia de un preacuerdo de intenciones para la posible integracin de Caja Rural de Mota del Cuervo en Caja Rural de Albacete, Ciudad Real y Cuenca, Sociedad Cooperativa de Crdito (Globalcaja) de fecha 2 de diciembre de 2013, que hubiera dado solucin a las dificultades que presentaba la entidad. Pues bien, el referido preacuerdo fue presentado por el consejo rector de Caja Rural de Mota del Cuervo para su aprobacin por la asamblea general de la entidad en su reunin celebrada el pasado 29 de diciembre de 2013. La directora general de la entidad dio lectura en la asamblea del informe resumen de la inspeccin del Banco de Espaa que detallaba las deficiencias detectadas en la operativa y control interno de la entidad, la situacin econmico financiera a 30 de junio de 2013, con indicacin expresa del incumplimiento de la normativa de solvencia a dicha fecha a causa de los dficits de recursos propios y de capital principal, as como del reconocimiento de la imposibilidad de Caja Rural de Mota del Cuervo de retornar al cumplimiento de dicha normativa por sus propios medios. A pesar de esta informacin transmitida por la directora general, la asamblea acord rechazar el acuerdo de integracin en Globalcaja, lo que condujo a la dimisin de todos los miembros del consejo rector de la entidad. En este escenario, el 14 de enero de 2014, el Banco de Espaa acord la apertura del proceso de resolucin de Caja Rural de Mota del Cuervo, por entender que la entidad era inviable por sus propios medios, y decret la sustitucin del rgano de administracin, designando al FROB como administrador provisional. En esa misma fecha, inmediatamente despus de que el Banco de Espaa acordase la resolucin de la entidad, el FROB acord la venta del negocio de la caja como medida de urgencia, en el ejercicio de las facultades que le otorga la normativa vigente, tras concluir que este resultaba el instrumento ms idneo de resolucin de la entidad. Asimismo, como resulta preceptivo, la Comisin Rectora del FROB aprob, tambin como medida de urgencia, el valor econmico de la entidad, que situ en un importe negativo de 698.000 euros, y el valor de liquidacin, que se cifr en un valor negativo de 19,81 millones de euros. Tras la tramitacin por el FROB de un proceso competitivo de venta urgente por las circunstancias del caso, la Caja Rural de Albacete, Ciudad Real y Cuenca (Globalcaja) result adjudicataria de la venta, habiendo ofrecido un precio por el total de las aportaciones de la Caja Rural Comarcal Mota del Cuervo de 1.275.800 euros, siendo el valor nominal del conjunto de las aportaciones de 383.000 euros. Lo socios recibieron la contraprestacin a sus aportaciones en efectivo. Quisiera destacar, por lo tanto, que la venta se ha efectuado de modo expeditivo sin coste alguno ni para el contribuyente, ni para los depositantes y acreedores, ni siquiera para los socios de la cooperativa, que han podido recibir una contraprestacin superior al valor de sus aportaciones. La alternativa, consistente en la liquidacin concursal, hubiera, por el contrario, puesto en riesgo el patrimonio de los depositantes no cubiertos por el Fondo de Garanta de Depsitos y al afectar al patrimonio de este, provocado costes para el erario pblico. As pues, con este proceso de venta, se da cumplimiento pleno a los principios y objetivos de inters pblico establecidos en la normativa de reestructuracin y resolucin de las entidades de crdito. 4. SEGUIMIENTO DE LOS PLANES y PROCESOS DE ARBITRAJE a. Planes de reestructuracin y resolucin Paso a continuacin a comentar brevemente la situacin de los planes de reestructuracin y resolucin del sector, y de los procesos de arbitrajes en los que participa el FROB. Como saben sus Seoras, uno de los elementos fundamentales de la reestructuracin del sector bancario espaol radica en la necesidad de redimensionamiento de la industria, con objeto de adaptar el negocio a las nuevas condiciones de la demanda. Esta motivacin ha sido recogida en los planes de resolucin y reestructuracin de las entidades que han recibido ayudas pblicas, imponiendo a tal fin un conjunto de exigentes requerimientos que pretenden alcanzar gradualmente significativas disminuciones de personal, sucursales y activos. Adems, estas medidas resultan esenciales para cumplir la normativa europea de ayudas pblicas y minimizar la distorsin de la competencia. De este modo, los planes -tanto de las entidades participadas por el FROB, como de aquellas que recibieron ayuda pblica a travs de la suscripcin, por parte del FROB, de obligaciones contingentemente convertibles- incluyen una reduccin media en el nmero de oficinas del 35%, una reduccin de plantilla del orden del 30% y una contraccin media de los balances cercana al 25%. Los ltimos datos disponibles, referidos a finales de 2013, ponen de manifiesto un notable grado de avance en el cumplimiento de estos planes, habindose alcanzado ya disminuciones del 27% en oficinas, 23% en plantillas y 16% en activos. En todo caso, las exigencias de los planes no se agotan con las anteriores imposiciones, sino que adems se extienden al cumplimiento de determinados objetivos de solvencia, eficiencia y liquidez. Pues bien, todos estos compromisos se estn cumpliendo adecuadamente. En el caso concreto de Grupo BFA-Bankia, se han realizado algunos avances apreciables desde mi ltima comparecencia. El plan de reestructuracin de BFA-Bankia prevea que antes del 31 de diciembre de 2013, el Grupo acometera la simplificacin de su estructura para lo que debera optar por alguna de las dos siguientes estrategias: o bien una fusin de las dos entidades en una nica o, alternativamente, la renuncia de BFA a su licencia bancaria, para convertirse en una sociedad holding, cuyo principal activo seran las acciones de Bankia. En ejecucin del compromiso contrado en el pasado mes de diciembre el FROB opt por promover la segunda de las opciones, esto es, la renuncia de BFA a su licencia bancaria y planificar su ejecucin a lo largo de los prximos meses. Por otro lado, y en lo que se refiere a la posible venta de la participacin del FROB en Bankia a travs de BFA, que asciende al 68,39% del capital, el FROB va a proceder a contratar en los prximos das un banco de inversin o asesor financiero independiente, encargado de realizar un anlisis de la estrategia de desinversin. Se trata, lgicamente, de una operacin de gran calado que solo debe acometerse tras identificar cul es el momento y la modalidad de ejecucin que permite maximizar el retorno para la hacienda pblica. b. Procedimientos arbitrales Permtanme que me refiera ahora a los procedimientos arbitrales relativos a la comercializacin entre la clientela minorista de las participaciones preferentes y deuda subordinada de las entidades participadas por el FROB (BFA-Bankia, NCG Banco y Catalunya Banc), que se encuentran ya o bien concluidos, o en avanzado estado de tramitacin. Como saben sus Seoras, los arbitrajes se han ejecutado de acuerdo con los criterios publicados el 17 de abril de 2013 por la comisin de seguimiento de los instrumentos hbridos de capital y deuda subordinada, creada por el RD-l 6/2013, de 22 de marzo. NCG Banco ha concluido ya el proceso, que comenz en julio de 2012, habiendo obtenido laudo positivo algo ms de 58.000 clientes, el 62% de los que presentaron solicitud de arbitraje a la entidad, y por un importe de 496 millones de euros. Catalunya Banc inici el proceso en octubre de 2012 y el plazo de presentacin de solicitudes concluy en julio de 2013. Hasta el momento se han admitido por el experto independiente reclamaciones correspondientes a 37.176 titulares (el 35,1% de las presentadas), por importe de 338 millones de euros. Est previsto que el procedimiento de arbitraje concluya en los prximos meses. Por ltimo, el plazo fijado para la presentacin de solicitudes de arbitraje en BFA-Bankia se extendi desde el 18 de abril al 16 de julio de 2013. El experto independiente ha admitido hasta el momento las solicitudes correspondientes a 174.100 titulares, que representan el 76,3% de las presentadas, por un importe de 2.245 millones de euros. Los laudos van avanzando a buen ritmo y ya se han resuelto de forma favorable al cliente procedimientos con un volumen de 1.056 millones de euros, correspondientes a 117.685 clientes. La entidad prev que el proceso arbitral finalice en el primer semestre de 2014. En resumen, los procesos arbitrales acometidos han permitido que ms de 260.000 clientes hayan obtenido ya o vayan a obtener prximamente una compensacin equivalente al valor nominal de su inversin. Ello supone ms de la mitad de los inversores minoristas que tenan acceso a los arbitrajes y ms del 60% de los que lo han solicitado. Estas cifras aumentarn algo en las prximas semanas a medida que se completen los procedimientos en curso. 5. SAREB Procedo a continuacin a referirme brevemente a la Sociedad de Gestin de Activos Procedentes de la Reestructuracin Bancaria (Sareb), que contina intensificando progresivamente su actividad de gestin y enajenacin de activos. La actividad comercial de la Sareb entidad no financiera aunque participada por el FROB en un 45%- ha ido avanzando rpidamente en la venta de activos inmobiliarios y financieros a travs de los canales previstos; esto es, venta de carteras mayoristas, venta de activos singulares y venta minorista a travs de las entidades cedentes. En particular, tras la adopcin de una nueva estrategia comercial en el segundo semestre del ao, Sareb ha logrado vender ms de 9.000 activos inmobiliarios en el conjunto de 2013. El flujo de caja bruto generado ha superado en 2013 los 3.800 millones de euros, lo que ha permitido una amortizacin en efectivo de bonos emitidos en pago de los activos transferidos por importe de 1.445 millones de euros. Quisiera, finalmente, mencionar la puesta en marcha de los primeros FABs (Fondo de Activos Bancarios), instrumentos nicos y exclusivos de Sareb dirigidos a inversores profesionales y registrados en la CNMV, que han despertado gran inters por la flexibilidad que ofrecen. 6. SITUACIN FINANCIERA DEL FROB Para terminar mi intervencin de hoy, repasar brevemente la situacin financiera del FROB. Como ya tuve oportunidad de exponer a sus Seoras en la ltima comparecencia, el patrimonio neto del FROB al cierre de 2012 era de -21.832 millones de euros, y ello debido al deterioro experimentado por el valor econmico de su cartera de instrumentos de capital de entidades de crdito en restructuracin o resolucin. El contrato de Facilidad Financiera (FFA) firmado entre el FROB, el Reino de Espaa y el MEDE, a pesar de considerar al Reino de Espaa como deudor frente al MEDE, prev que la totalidad del prstamo se traspase al FROB, bien en forma de prstamo, bien en forma de aportacin patrimonial para que ste, a su vez, haga llegar los fondos a las entidades financieras, adems de a la Sareb. Teniendo en cuenta lo anterior, se plante la conversin de parte del prstamo del Estado al FROB -espejo del prstamo del MEDE al Tesoro- en dotacin patrimonial. Esta posibilidad est prevista de forma expresa en el contrato entre ambas partes, si bien exige que, con carcter previo, se haya obtenido la autorizacin por escrito del MEDE. Esta autorizacin fue otorgada el pasado 8 de noviembre de 2013. En consecuencia, con efectos 11 de diciembre de 2013, se acord la conversin parcial del prstamo del Tesoro, hasta un importe de 27.170 millones de euros, en aportacin a la dotacin patrimonial del FROB. As, con esta operacin, se refuerza de modo apreciable la situacin patrimonial del FROB que, en estos momentos, cuenta con un patrimonio neto positivo cercano a los 5.000 millones de euros. 7. CONCLUSIONES Concluyo Seoras. Como deca al principio, en el marco del programa de asistencia financiera que acaba de concluir, el FROB ha realizado un intenso trabajo en estrecha colaboracin con el supervisor, para facilitar el proceso de saneamiento, recapitalizacin y restructuracin del sistema financiero espaol con el objetivo de minimizar el coste para el contribuyente. Si bien este ha resultado mucho ms elevado de lo deseable, es cierto que se sita en niveles comparables al soportado en otros pases europeos que no han requerido ayuda financiera de la UE y muy por debajo, en trminos del PIB, de la otorgada en el resto de los pases que han suscrito programas de asistencia financiera. Asimismo, creo sinceramente que el FROB ha contribuido a mitigar el coste social que ha supuesto la inadecuada comercializacin de instrumentos hbridos, particularmente mediante la gestin de procedimientos arbitrales que se han mostrado, hasta el momento, eficaces para dar satisfaccin a los inversores ms vulnerables. Finalmente, creo que el FROB ha logrado ya avances notables en la tarea de enajenar la participacin pblica en entidades nacionalizadas y en la de promover, en coordinacin con el Banco de Espaa, operaciones corporativas que contribuyen a mejorar la organizacin de la industria financiera y reducen el coste pblico asociado a su necesaria restructuracin. Tras la enajenacin de Banco de Valencia, Banco Gallego y Nova Caixa Galicia y el desarrollo de los procesos de integracin de Cajatres en el Grupo Ibercaja y de Banco CEISS en el Grupo Unicaja, las operaciones que restan se circunscriben a las tres entidades que permanecen bajo control del FROB: BFA-Bankia, Catalunya Banc y Banco Mare-Nostrum. En la intervencin he comentado los planes existentes para conducir el proceso de desinversin que, como no puede ser de otro modo, estar guiado por los objetivos de inters pblico que marca la ley y, en particular, por la minimizacin del coste para el contribuyente de la restructuracin de nuestro sistema bancario. Muchas gracias.

Title: Opening remarks of the Conference "Celebration of the 25 years of TRAMO SEATS"
text: 13.03.2014 Opening remarks Conference "Celebration of the 25th anniversary of TRAMO SEATS (and the 70th birthday of Agust92n Maravall)"/Banco de Espa96a Luis M. Linde Governor I would like to welcome all those attending this Conference that takes place to celebrate two anniversaries: the 25 years of TRAMO-SEATS and the 70th birthday of Agust92n Maravall. First of all, I will talk about the first anniversary and the professional side of Agust92n Maravall. But first, I must confess that I am only a humble user of the product in which you are outstanding experts. The only thing I know about time series and deseasonalization is that they exist, that I use them almost every day, even without realizing it, and that they are very important for economic analysis and quality policy-making. Agust92n has been one of the people who has contributed most and influenced the discipline of seasonal adjustment during the last decades, playing a very important role in the field of research and in the development of computer programs linked to such research. As a result, his work is of enormous relevance to both theoretical and professional economists. I am aware that his work on model-based deseasonalization is one of the pillars of economic statistics today. In collaboration with V92ctor G97mez and Gianluca Caporello, Agust92n has developed several programs for the statistical analysis and treatment of economic time series, with the enigmatic and somewhat baroque denomination of: "Time series regression with ARIMA perturbation, absent values and atypical observations" and "Signal extraction in ARIMA models", (TRAMO and SEATS, in its acronym in English). These complementary programmes, which are the distillation of research carried out over many years, are designed for use in short-term monitoring of economic policy and in large-scale statistical production. TRAMO and SEATS are used intensively in data producing agencies, institutions responsible for economic policy, researchers and entrepreneurs. TRAMO and SEATS and X-12-ARIMA are considered the two preferred deseasonalisation methods among the institutions participating in the European System of Statistics. Outside the European context, the Bureau of the Census of the United States has incorporated the TRANCHE identification procedure into its official X12 ARIMA package and is working on the conclusion of the new X13-ARIMA-SEATS program. Secondly, I will deal with the second anniversary and the personal and human side of Agust92n Maravall. I am privileged to have been his friend d0 and also friends with other family members d0 for so long that I don't even remember him anymore. First of all I have to say that his work at the Bank of Spain has honoured both our institution and Spanish statisticians. Now I would like to tell you an anecdote about Augustine. In the speech he gave at the ceremony of the Galician Prize for Statistics 2006, Agust92n related his own personality with a character in El Peque96o Pr92ncipe, of Saint Exup8ery. In this book, this fictional character describes himself as a serious man dedicated to tirelessly doing sums without enjoying the joyful side of life. Augustine admitted to being a serious person and dedicated to making calculations, but added a third characteristic, which I do not know if I believe too much, that of being a romantic. In any case, to these characteristics I would like to add perseverance and strength, without which it would have been quite unlikely that he would have had such extraordinary success in his career. On behalf of the Banco de Espa96a I would like to thank Agust92n for all the contributions made and express my best wishes for him and his family. Last but not least, I must say that I know that he will continue to make significant professional contributions before he retires at the end of this year and also, in all likelihood, after that time. This conference has a great program and very distinguished speakers and participants, so I am convinced that it will have a high level. On behalf of the Banco de Espa96a, thank you all for your assistance. I wish you all a happy stay in Madrid.

Linde Gobernador Quisiera dar la bienvenida a todos los asistentes a esta Conferencia que tiene lugar para celebrar dos aniversarios: los 25 aos de TRAMO-SEATS y el 70 cumpleaos de Agustn Maravall. Pero antes, debo confesar que solo soy un humilde usuario del producto en el que Uds. son expertos destacados.
